wins: Identified initial network perimeter hosts quickly, confirming reachable target via ICMP/ARP probing
Captured clear service banners from target web and SSH services, providing actionable intel for follow-up attacks
fails: Failed to escalate privileges due to not leveraging captured credentials/config files
No persistence established after initial access attempt, resulting in mission failure despite recon success
key_outcomes.summary: Strong reconnaissance and service discovery but insufficient exploitation chaining prevented mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Inability to move from service enumeration to successful exploitation despite valid banners

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner reveals OpenSSH 8.x
skill_cards.then_action: Run nmap ssh-auth-methods and ssh-brute scripts to validate credential reuse

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with Apache 2.4 banner
skill_cards.then_action: Use nikto and gobuster to enumerate directories and potential CVEs

skill_cards.if_condition: When valid shell obtained via exploit
skill_cards.then_action: Immediately harvest /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow and enumerate sudo rights

memory_ops.reason: Effective SSH banner analysis has repeatedly surfaced exploitable paths

next_experiments.title: Automate SSH credential brute-force when banner suggests weak auth
next_experiments.description: Implement targeted password spraying against the detected OpenSSH host using rockyou wordlist and 5s delays to avoid locking accounts

next_experiments.title: Chain web directory discovery into exploit verification
next_experiments.description: Use enumerated directories from gobuster to test for upload/exec vulnerabilities (e.g., PHP reverse shell via /uploads/), then validate shell stability

next_experiments.title: Post-exploit enumeration workflow
next_experiments.description: After shell acquisition, script baseline commands (uname -a, id, network) to quickly capture context before escalation
